title: Go Fast video recorded off Jacksonville
place_text: 300 miles off Jacksonville, Florida, USS Roosevelt

tellings.quote: let's get into uh the Go Fast video which was recorded in January of 2015, 300 miles off the coast of Jacksonville, the USS Roosevelt.

tellings.difference: Presents the crew audio itself rather than the host's account of when and where the video was recorded.
tellings.link_reason: The crew's reaction on the Go Fast audio is the Go Fast video recorded in 2015 off the East Coast.

plain: In January 2015, Navy aircrew flying from the aircraft carrier USS Roosevelt, about 300 miles off the coast of Jacksonville, Florida, are said to have filmed a small object racing low over the ocean. The clip became known as the Go Fast video, named for how quickly the object seemed to move. Michels sets out the date and place himself, as background to a talk with a well-known UFO skeptic. The other telling comes from the aircrew themselves: their recorded cockpit voices are played, and one can be heard saying "Oh my gosh, dude. Wow." So one telling gives the host's account of when and where it happened, and the other gives the reaction of the people who saw it. It matters to the people who tell it because trained military crews, on their own instruments, recorded something they could not name.
